metadata.title: Learnigo - Science / Read
metadata.subject: Science
metadata.generated_for: Children with dyslexia and other learning differences, approx. ages 5-10
design_principles: Every question requires reading printed science facts, diagrams, passages, or data - no audio does the work.
Diagram literacy (labelling, part-location) is treated as a first-class science-reading skill, not an afterthought.
Wrong options are never random. Each one names a specific misconception or a plausible-but-wrong distractor.
Three difficulty bands rotate inside every type: easy for fluency, medium for the learning edge, happy for pure joy.
Passage and inference items (types 14-15) deliberately test comprehension stamina and reasoning depth, not just fact recall.
Feedback praises the process, never the child's intelligence.
Read-aloud support (audio_text) remains available as an accommodation on every item, even though the target skill is print reading.
Safety, honesty and help-seeking items carry a mastery_weight above 1.0 so they surface in reports even when accuracy overall is high.

tts_guidance.note: Read audio_text exactly as written when read-aloud support is used. For sequence and multi-select items, pause 500ms between listed items.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: decoding a written science statement and matching it to meaning
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline print science literacy, connecting decoding directly to factual content.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: checking a printed statement against known science facts
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Print reading combined with fact-checking, a step up from purely auditory verification.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: turning a printed science word into its correct image
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Isolated science-vocabulary decoding, separate from any sentence context.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reading labels then reasoning about a real scientific relationship between them
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Moves beyond word-picture matching into genuine relational science reasoning.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: connecting printed text to a specific location in a visual diagram
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Diagram literacy is a distinct science-reading skill, used constantly in real textbooks.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: applying one classification rule repeatedly across several read words
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a science category, once understood, holds up across a full set without losing focus.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding three decoded science words in mind and identifying which breaks the pattern
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Combines decoding three words with genuine scientific classification reasoning.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reading several process steps and ordering them correctly
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Print version of process sequencing, requiring decoding and structural reasoning together.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reasoning from a read cause to its most likely read effect
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Print-based cause-and-effect reasoning, the seed of later scientific prediction skills.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: decoding a comparison statement and identifying the correct visual match
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Combines reading comprehension with comparative reasoning about physical properties.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reading a category rule then evaluating multiple printed options against it
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Print multi-select is more demanding than single-answer reading - every option must be actively checked.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding several term-definition pairs in mind while matching them
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: A genuine vocabulary-depth check, going beyond picture matching into real definitional understanding.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: reading labelled data and answering a question about it
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Science-context data reading, connecting graph literacy directly to real investigation results.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: holding multiple connected science sentences in mind together
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether comprehension holds up as science text length grows, a common dyslexia drop-off point.

question_type_registry.primary_construct: combining information from printed text to reach a conclusion not directly stated
question_type_registry.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - genuine scientific inference from text, the destination all other Read types build toward.

difficulty_band.easy: Consolidation. Child should succeed ~90% of the time. Builds fluency and confidence.
difficulty_band.medium: Learning edge. Target ~65-75% success. This is where growth data lives.
difficulty_band.happy: Pure joy question. Near-certain success, silly or warm content, low mastery weight. Placed to reset mood after effort and to keep the session feeling like play.

reporting_recipes.skill_profile: Group accuracy by academic.skill and cognition.process to find the child's cognitive shape (e.g. strong discriminate / weak sequence).
reporting_recipes.life_skill_radar: Group accuracy by life_skill.domain across all subjects to build a 14-spoke life-skill radar chart per child.
reporting_recipes.dyslexia_error_map: Count wrong answers by distractor_insight value, not just by question. The distractor tells you WHY, so one wrong tap becomes a diagnosis.
reporting_recipes.attention_curve: Plot time_to_first_touch and accuracy against telemetry.session_position to find the child's real attention span, then cap session length there.
reporting_recipes.working_memory_ceiling: Accuracy vs cognition.working_memory_load. The load level where accuracy drops below 60% is the child's current WM ceiling - never exceed it during teaching.
reporting_recipes.confidence_calibration: Compare the wellbeing.confidence_prompt answer with actual correctness. Confident+wrong = misconception to correct. Unsure+right = needs reassurance, not more teaching.
reporting_recipes.impulsivity_index: Wrong answers where time_to_first_touch < 25% of expected_response_time_ms. High index means teach 'wait and think', not more content.
reporting_recipes.persistence_index: Retry rate and abandon rate on medium-band items. Falling persistence over weeks is an early wellbeing flag.
reporting_recipes.mood_trend: Track emotion_checkin responses over sessions. Two sad check-ins in a row should lower difficulty automatically for the next session.
reporting_recipes.personality_map: Aggregate personality_signal outcomes to describe tendencies (e.g. cautious, highly pro-social, low help-seeking) for the parent report.

wellbeing_rules: No question ever shows a countdown clock. Speed is rewarded, never punished.
Feedback praises the process ('you listened right to the end'), never the child's intelligence.
After two wrong answers the app shows how it works instead of asking again.
A happy-band question follows any run of three errors.
Every safety and help-seeking question points the child towards a trusted grown-up.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the fact. Tap the picture.
questions.prompt: Fish live in water.
hints: Where does the sentence say fish live?
questions.worked_example: Read the whole sentence. Picture what it describes before choosing.

feedback.correct: Water. Correctly read and matched. 🐟🌊
feedback.incorrect: Read the whole sentence again - where does it say fish live?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: reading a science fact and matching its image

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Fish breathe through gills, made specifically for living in water.

analysis.primary_construct: decoding a written science statement and matching it to meaning
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline print science literacy, connecting decoding directly to factual content.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Choosing an image based on one recognised word rather than the full sentence suggests partial reading, not full comprehension.
analysis.parent_note: Reading science facts, not just hearing them, is where subject literacy really begins.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Read the whole sentence aloud together before choosing.

es.worked_example: Lee la frase completa. Imagina lo que describe antes de elegir.

feedback.correct: Girar la cabeza muy lejos. Leído y relacionado correctamente. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Lee la frase completa otra vez: ¿qué pueden hacer de especial los búhos?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Lis le fait. Touche l'image.
fr.prompt: Les hiboux ont des os du cou supplémentaires, ce qui leur permet de tourner la tête très loin.
hints: Quelle capacité spéciale la phrase décrit-elle ?
fr.worked_example: Lis toute la phrase. Imagine ce qu'elle décrit avant de choisir.

feedback.correct: Tourner la tête très loin. Bien lu et associé. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Relis toute la phrase - que peuvent faire les hiboux de spécial ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Leia o fato. Toque na imagem.
pt.prompt: As corujas têm ossos extras no pescoço, o que lhes permite girar a cabeça bem longe.
hints: Que habilidade especial a frase descreve?
pt.worked_example: Leia a frase toda. Imagine o que ela descreve antes de escolher.

feedback.correct: Girar a cabeça bem longe. Lido e combinado corretamente. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Leia a frase toda outra vez - o que de especial as corujas conseguem fazer?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi il fatto. Tocca l'immagine.
it.prompt: I gufi hanno ossa del collo in più, che permettono loro di girare la testa molto lontano.
hints: Quale abilità speciale descrive la frase?
it.worked_example: Leggi tutta la frase. Immagina quello che descrive prima di scegliere.

feedback.correct: Girare la testa molto lontano. Letto e abbinato correttamente. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Leggi di nuovo tutta la frase - cosa possono fare di speciale i gufi?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies die Tatsache. Tippe auf das Bild.
de.prompt: Eulen haben zusätzliche Halsknochen, wodurch sie ihren Kopf sehr weit drehen können.
hints: Welche besondere Fähigkeit beschreibt der Satz?
de.worked_example: Lies den ganzen Satz. Stell dir vor, was er beschreibt, bevor du wählst.

feedback.correct: Den Kopf sehr weit drehen. Richtig gelesen und zugeordnet. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Lies den ganzen Satz noch einmal - was können Eulen Besonderes?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen - schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Lees het weetje. Tik op het plaatje.
nl.prompt: Uilen hebben extra nekwervels, waardoor ze hun kop heel ver kunnen draaien.
hints: Welk speciaal vermogen beschrijft de zin?
nl.worked_example: Lees de hele zin. Stel je voor wat hij beschrijft voordat je kiest.

feedback.correct: Hun kop heel ver draaien. Juist gelezen en gekoppeld. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Lees de hele zin nog een keer - wat kunnen uilen speciaals?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Прочитай факт. Нажми на картинку.
ru.prompt: У сов есть дополнительные кости в шее, которые позволяют им поворачивать голову очень далеко.
hints: Какую особую способность описывает предложение?
ru.worked_example: Прочитай всё предложение. Представь, что оно описывает, перед тем как выбрать.

feedback.correct: Поворачивать голову очень далеко. Правильно прочитано и сопоставлено. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Прочитай предложение ещё раз — что особенное умеют совы?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.prompt: Baykuşların fazladan boyun kemikleri vardır, bu da başlarını çok uzağa döndürmelerini sağlar.
hints: Cümle hangi özel yeteneği anlatıyor?
tr.worked_example: Cümlenin tamamını oku. Seçmeden önce anlattığını gözünde canlandır.

feedback.correct: Başlarını çok uzağa döndürmek. Doğru okundu ve eşleştirildi. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Cümlenin tamamını tekrar oku - baykuşlar hangi özel şeyi yapabilir?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 读事实。点击图片。
zh.prompt: 猫头鹰的脖子里有额外的骨头,这让它们能把头转得很远。
hints: 句子里描述了什么特殊能力?
zh.worked_example: 读完整句话。选择前想象它描述的画面。

feedback.correct: 把头转得很远。读对了,也匹配对了。🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: 再读一遍整句话——猫头鹰能做什么特殊的事?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 文を読もう。絵をタップしよう。
ja.prompt: フクロウは余分な首の骨があり、頭をとても大きく回すことができる。
hints: 文はどんな特別な能力を説明している?
ja.worked_example: 文全体を読もう。選ぶ前に、何が書かれているか想像しよう。

feedback.correct: 頭を大きく回せること。正しく読んで選べたね。🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: もう一度文を読もう。フクロウにできる特別なことは何?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 올빼미는 목뼈가 더 많아서 머리를 아주 멀리 돌릴 수 있어요.
hints: 문장에서 어떤 특별한 능력을 설명했나요?
ko.worked_example: 문장 전체를 읽으세요. 선택하기 전에 그 내용을 그려보세요.

feedback.correct: 머리를 아주 멀리 돌리기. 정확히 읽고 맞췄어요. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: 문장을 다시 읽어보세요 - 올빼미는 어떤 특별한 일을 할 수 있나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.prompt: Burung hantu memiliki tulang leher ekstra, yang membuat mereka bisa memutar kepala sangat jauh.
hints: Kemampuan khusus apa yang digambarkan kalimat itu?
id.worked_example: Baca seluruh kalimatnya. Bayangkan apa yang digambarkan sebelum memilih.

feedback.correct: Memutar kepala sangat jauh. Dibaca dan dicocokkan dengan benar. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Baca seluruh kalimatnya lagi - hal khusus apa yang bisa dilakukan burung hantu?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Đọc sự kiện. Chạm vào hình đúng.
vi.prompt: Cú có thêm xương cổ, giúp chúng quay đầu được rất xa.
hints: Câu văn miêu tả khả năng đặc biệt gì?
vi.worked_example: Đọc cả câu. Hình dung điều câu đó miêu tả trước khi chọn.

feedback.correct: Quay đầu được rất xa. Đọc và chọn đúng. 🦉🔄
feedback.incorrect: Đọc lại cả câu - cú có thể làm điều đặc biệt gì?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này với nhau - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the fact. Tap the picture.
questions.prompt: A rainbow forms when sunlight passes through raindrops and splits into colours.

distractor_insight.🌈🌙💧: read partly, wrong light source matched

hints: What two things does the sentence say are needed for a rainbow?
questions.worked_example: Read the whole sentence. Picture what it describes before choosing.

feedback.correct: Sunlight and raindrops. Correctly read and matched. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Read the whole sentence again - what two things does it mention together?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: reading a science fact and matching its image

life_skill.hidden_lesson: A rainbow is really sunlight splitting apart into all its hidden colours.

analysis.primary_construct: decoding a written science statement and matching it to meaning
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Baseline print science literacy, connecting decoding directly to factual content.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Choosing an image based on one recognised word rather than the full sentence suggests partial reading, not full comprehension.
analysis.parent_note: Reading science facts, not just hearing them, is where subject literacy really begins.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Read the whole sentence aloud together before choosing.

es.instruction: Lee el dato. Toca la imagen.
es.prompt: Un arcoíris se forma cuando la luz del sol pasa a través de gotas de lluvia y se divide en colores.
hints: ¿Qué dos cosas dice la frase que se necesitan para un arcoíris?
es.worked_example: Lee la frase completa. Imagina lo que describe antes de elegir.

feedback.correct: Luz del sol y gotas de lluvia. Leído y relacionado correctamente. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Lee la frase completa otra vez: ¿qué dos cosas se mencionan juntas?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Lis le fait. Touche l'image.
fr.prompt: Un arc-en-ciel se forme quand la lumière du soleil passe à travers des gouttes de pluie et se divise en couleurs.
hints: Quelles deux choses la phrase dit-elle nécessaires pour un arc-en-ciel ?
fr.worked_example: Lis toute la phrase. Imagine ce qu'elle décrit avant de choisir.

feedback.correct: La lumière du soleil et les gouttes de pluie. Bien lu et associé. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Relis toute la phrase - quelles deux choses sont mentionnées ensemble ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Leia o fato. Toque na imagem.
pt.prompt: Um arco-íris se forma quando a luz do sol passa pelas gotas de chuva e se divide em cores.
hints: Que duas coisas a frase diz que são necessárias para um arco-íris?
pt.worked_example: Leia a frase toda. Imagine o que ela descreve antes de escolher.

feedback.correct: Luz do sol e gotas de chuva. Lido e combinado corretamente. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Leia a frase toda outra vez - que duas coisas ela menciona juntas?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi il fatto. Tocca l'immagine.
it.prompt: Un arcobaleno si forma quando la luce del sole passa attraverso le gocce di pioggia e si divide in colori.
hints: Quali due cose dice la frase che sono necessarie per un arcobaleno?
it.worked_example: Leggi tutta la frase. Immagina quello che descrive prima di scegliere.

feedback.correct: Luce del sole e gocce di pioggia. Letto e abbinato correttamente. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Leggi di nuovo tutta la frase - quali due cose menziona insieme?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies die Tatsache. Tippe auf das Bild.
de.prompt: Ein Regenbogen entsteht, wenn Sonnenlicht durch Regentropfen fällt und sich in Farben aufspaltet.
hints: Welche zwei Dinge, sagt der Satz, braucht man für einen Regenbogen?
de.worked_example: Lies den ganzen Satz. Stell dir vor, was er beschreibt, bevor du wählst.

feedback.correct: Sonnenlicht und Regentropfen. Richtig gelesen und zugeordnet. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Lies den ganzen Satz noch einmal - welche zwei Dinge werden zusammen genannt?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen - schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Lees het weetje. Tik op het plaatje.
nl.prompt: Een regenboog ontstaat wanneer zonlicht door regendruppels valt en zich splitst in kleuren.
hints: Welke twee dingen zijn nodig voor een regenboog, volgens de zin?
nl.worked_example: Lees de hele zin. Stel je voor wat hij beschrijft voordat je kiest.

feedback.correct: Zonlicht en regendruppels. Juist gelezen en gekoppeld. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Lees de hele zin nog een keer - welke twee dingen worden samen genoemd?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Прочитай факт. Нажми на картинку.
ru.prompt: Радуга образуется, когда солнечный свет проходит через капли дождя и разделяется на цвета.
hints: Какие две вещи, согласно предложению, нужны для радуги?
ru.worked_example: Прочитай всё предложение. Представь, что оно описывает, перед тем как выбрать.

feedback.correct: Солнечный свет и капли дождя. Правильно прочитано и сопоставлено. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Прочитай предложение ещё раз — какие две вещи упомянуты вместе?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.prompt: Bir gökkuşağı, güneş ışığı yağmur damlalarından geçip renklere ayrıldığında oluşur.
hints: Cümle bir gökkuşağı için hangi iki şeyin gerekli olduğunu söylüyor?
tr.worked_example: Cümlenin tamamını oku. Seçmeden önce anlattığını gözünde canlandır.

feedback.correct: Güneş ışığı ve yağmur damlaları. Doğru okundu ve eşleştirildi. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Cümlenin tamamını tekrar oku - birlikte hangi iki şeyden bahsediyor?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 读事实。点击图片。
zh.prompt: 当阳光穿过雨滴并分解成不同颜色时,就形成了彩虹。
hints: 句子里说彩虹需要哪两样东西?
zh.worked_example: 读完整句话。选择前想象它描述的画面。

feedback.correct: 阳光和雨滴。读对了,也匹配对了。🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: 再读一遍整句话——它一起提到了哪两样东西?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 文を読もう。絵をタップしよう。
ja.prompt: 虹は、太陽の光が雨粒を通って色に分かれるときにできる。
hints: 虹に必要な2つのものは何だと書いてある?
ja.worked_example: 文全体を読もう。選ぶ前に、何が書かれているか想像しよう。

feedback.correct: 太陽の光と雨粒。正しく読んで選べたね。🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: もう一度文を読もう。文が一緒に挙げている2つのものは何?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 무지개는 햇빛이 빗방울을 지나며 여러 색으로 나뉠 때 생겨요.
hints: 문장에서 무지개가 생기려면 두 가지가 필요하다고 했는데, 그 두 가지는 무엇인가요?
ko.worked_example: 문장 전체를 읽으세요. 선택하기 전에 그 내용을 그려보세요.

feedback.correct: 햇빛과 빗방울. 정확히 읽고 맞췄어요. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: 문장을 다시 읽어보세요 - 두 가지를 함께 말하고 있어요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.prompt: Pelangi terbentuk saat sinar matahari melewati tetesan air hujan dan terurai menjadi warna-warna.
hints: Dua hal apa yang dikatakan kalimat itu diperlukan untuk pelangi?
id.worked_example: Baca seluruh kalimatnya. Bayangkan apa yang digambarkan sebelum memilih.

feedback.correct: Sinar matahari dan tetesan air hujan. Dibaca dan dicocokkan dengan benar. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Baca seluruh kalimatnya lagi - dua hal apa yang disebutkan bersama-sama?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Đọc sự kiện. Chạm vào hình đúng.
vi.prompt: Cầu vồng hình thành khi ánh nắng mặt trời xuyên qua các hạt mưa và tách thành nhiều màu.
hints: Câu văn nói cần hai thứ gì để có cầu vồng?
vi.worked_example: Đọc cả câu. Hình dung điều câu đó miêu tả trước khi chọn.

feedback.correct: Ánh nắng mặt trời và hạt mưa. Đọc và chọn đúng. 🌈☀️💧
feedback.incorrect: Đọc lại cả câu - câu nhắc đến hai thứ gì cùng với nhau?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này với nhau - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the sentence. Is it true?
questions.prompt: Fish live in water.

distractor_insight.❌ False: didn't reread the sentence before answering

hints: Reread the sentence carefully.
questions.worked_example: Read the whole sentence. Does it match what you already know?

feedback.correct: True. Fish do live in water. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Read the sentence again slowly before deciding.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: verifying a written science fact

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Checking a written claim carefully is a real reading and science skill together.

analysis.primary_construct: checking a printed statement against known science facts
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Print reading combined with fact-checking, a step up from purely auditory verification.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Fast wrong taps regardless of content suggest reading only part of the sentence before deciding.
analysis.parent_note: Reading carefully enough to fact-check is a real comprehension skill, not just decoding.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Ask your child to point to the exact word that changed their mind.

es.instruction: Lee la frase. ¿Es verdadera?
es.prompt: Los peces viven en el agua.
hints: Vuelve a leer la frase con atención.
es.worked_example: Lee la frase completa. ¿Coincide con lo que ya sabes?

feedback.correct: Verdadero. Los peces sí viven en el agua. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Lee la frase otra vez, despacio, antes de decidir.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Lis la phrase. Est-ce vrai ?
fr.prompt: Les poissons vivent dans l'eau.
hints: Relis la phrase attentivement.
fr.worked_example: Lis toute la phrase. Correspond-elle à ce que tu sais déjà ?

feedback.correct: Vrai. Les poissons vivent bien dans l'eau. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Relis la phrase lentement avant de décider.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Leia a frase. É verdade?
pt.prompt: Os peixes vivem na água.
hints: Releia a frase com atenção.
pt.worked_example: Leia a frase toda. Ela combina com o que você já sabe?

feedback.correct: Verdadeiro. Os peixes realmente vivem na água. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Leia a frase outra vez, devagar, antes de decidir.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi la frase. È vera?
it.prompt: I pesci vivono nell'acqua.
hints: Rileggi la frase con attenzione.
it.worked_example: Leggi tutta la frase. Corrisponde a quello che già sai?

feedback.correct: Vero. I pesci vivono davvero nell'acqua. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Leggi di nuovo la frase lentamente prima di decidere.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies den Satz. Ist er wahr?
de.prompt: Fische leben im Wasser.
hints: Lies den Satz noch einmal sorgfältig.
de.worked_example: Lies den ganzen Satz. Stimmt er mit dem überein, was du schon weißt?

feedback.correct: Wahr. Fische leben tatsächlich im Wasser. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Lies den Satz noch einmal langsam, bevor du dich entscheidest.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen - schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Lees de zin. Is hij waar?
nl.prompt: Vissen leven in water.
hints: Lees de zin nog eens goed.
nl.worked_example: Lees de hele zin. Komt hij overeen met wat je al weet?

feedback.correct: Waar. Vissen leven echt in water. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Lees de zin nog eens langzaam voordat je beslist.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Прочитай предложение. Это правда?
ru.prompt: Рыбы живут в воде.
hints: Перечитай предложение внимательно.
ru.worked_example: Прочитай всё предложение. Совпадает ли оно с тем, что ты уже знаешь?

feedback.correct: Правда. Рыбы действительно живут в воде. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Прочитай предложение снова, медленно, перед тем как решить.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

hints: Cümleyi dikkatlice tekrar oku.
tr.worked_example: Cümlenin tamamını oku. Bildiklerinle uyuşuyor mu?

feedback.correct: Doğru. Balıklar gerçekten suda yaşar. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Karar vermeden önce cümleyi tekrar yavaşça oku.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 读句子。这是真的吗?
zh.prompt: 鱼生活在水里。
hints: 仔细重读这句话。
zh.worked_example: 读完整句话。这和你已经知道的一致吗?

feedback.correct: 对。鱼确实生活在水里。🐟
feedback.incorrect: 决定之前慢慢再读一遍这句话。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 文を読もう。これは正しい?
ja.prompt: 魚は水の中で暮らす。
hints: もう一度よく文を読もう。
ja.worked_example: 文全体を読もう。すでに知っていることと合っている?

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read three words. Tap the odd one out.
questions.prompt: penguin  ostrich  eagle

distractor_insight.penguin: first word chosen, though penguin and ostrich are both flightless

hints: Two of these birds can't fly, one definitely can.
questions.worked_example: Read each word. Two share something in common. Which one doesn't?

feedback.correct: Eagle. Penguin and ostrich are flightless, but eagle can fly. 🦅
feedback.incorrect: Two can't fly at all. Which one actually can?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: classifying printed science terms by finding an exception

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Not every bird can fly - penguins and ostriches are both grounded.

analysis.primary_construct: holding three decoded science words in mind and identifying which breaks the pattern
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Combines decoding three words with genuine scientific classification reasoning.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Picking the visually longest or shortest word instead of the conceptually different one shows print bias overriding reasoning.
analysis.parent_note: Working out the hidden rule connecting two words is real scientific classification, done as reading practice.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Read all three words aloud together before choosing.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the steps. Put them in order.
questions.prompt: Egg. Caterpillar. Cocoon. Butterfly.
hints: The egg always comes first.
questions.worked_example: Read all the steps first. Which one absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.incorrect: Which stage is the very beginning of a butterfly's life?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a printed science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Every butterfly goes through all four of these stages, in exactly this order.

analysis.primary_construct: reading several process steps and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Print version of process sequencing, requiring decoding and structural reasoning together.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct steps in the wrong order after accurate reading shows sequencing, not decoding, is the actual gap.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that a process happens in stages, read directly from text, is real science literacy.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Number each step lightly in pencil before dragging, if that helps organise thinking.

zh.instruction: 读一读这些步骤,把它们排好顺序。

feedback.correct: 生まれる、足が育つ、尾がなくなる、カエル - 一生のサイクル全部を読んで順番にできたね。🐸
feedback.incorrect: カエルの一生のいちばん最初の段階はどれ?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 올챙이가 알에서 나와요. 다리가 자라요. 꼬리가 줄어들어요. 개구리가 돼요.
hints: 올챙이는 알 속에서 시작해요.
ko.worked_example: 모든 단계를 먼저 읽으세요. 반드시 가장 먼저 일어나야 하는 것은 무엇인가요?

feedback.correct: 부화, 다리 자람, 꼬리 줄어듦, 개구리 - 전체 생애 주기를 읽고 순서대로 맞췄어요. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: 개구리의 삶에서 맨 처음 단계는 무엇인가요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.prompt: Kecebong menetas. Ia menumbuhkan kaki. Ekornya menyusut. Ia menjadi katak.
hints: Kecebong mulai di dalam telur.
id.worked_example: Baca semua langkahnya terlebih dahulu. Langkah mana yang pasti terjadi lebih dulu?

feedback.correct: Menetas, menumbuhkan kaki, ekor menyusut, menjadi katak - seluruh siklus hidupnya, dibaca dan diurutkan dengan benar. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Tahap mana yang merupakan awal mula kehidupan katak?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Đọc các bước. Sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự.
vi.prompt: Nòng nọc nở ra. Nó mọc chân. Đuôi nó ngắn lại. Nó trở thành ếch.
hints: Nòng nọc bắt đầu từ trong một quả trứng.
vi.worked_example: Đọc hết tất cả các bước trước. Bước nào chắc chắn phải xảy ra đầu tiên?

feedback.correct: Nở ra, mọc chân, mất đuôi, thành ếch - cả vòng đời, đọc và sắp xếp đúng. 🐸
feedback.incorrect: Giai đoạn nào là khởi đầu của đời một con ếch?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này với nhau - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the steps. Put them in order.
questions.prompt: Volcano builds pressure. It erupts. Lava flows. It cools into rock.
hints: Pressure builds quietly for a long time before anything happens.
questions.worked_example: Read all the steps first. Which one absolutely has to happen first?

feedback.correct: Pressure, erupt, flow, cool - the whole process, read and ordered. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: What happens deep underground for a long time before an eruption?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: sequencing a printed science process

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Volcanoes can be quiet for years while pressure slowly builds underground.

analysis.primary_construct: reading several process steps and ordering them correctly
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Print version of process sequencing, requiring decoding and structural reasoning together.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct steps in the wrong order after accurate reading shows sequencing, not decoding, is the actual gap.
analysis.parent_note: Understanding that a process happens in stages, read directly from text, is real science literacy.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Number each step lightly in pencil before dragging, if that helps organise thinking.

es.instruction: Lee los pasos. Ponlos en orden.
es.prompt: El volcán acumula presión. Hace erupción. La lava fluye. Se enfría y se vuelve roca.
options: se enfría y se vuelve roca
correct_answer: se enfría y se vuelve roca
accepted_answers: se enfría y se vuelve roca
hints: La presión se acumula en silencio durante mucho tiempo antes de que pase algo.
es.worked_example: Lee todos los pasos primero. ¿Cuál tiene que ocurrir absolutamente primero?

feedback.correct: Presión, erupción, flujo, enfriamiento: todo el proceso, leído y ordenado. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: ¿Qué pasa muy abajo, bajo tierra, durante mucho tiempo antes de una erupción?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Lis les étapes. Mets-les dans l'ordre.
fr.prompt: Le volcan accumule de la pression. Il entre en éruption. La lave coule. Elle se refroidit en roche.
hints: La pression s'accumule silencieusement pendant longtemps avant que quoi que ce soit n'arrive.
fr.worked_example: Lis d'abord toutes les étapes. Laquelle doit absolument se produire en premier ?

feedback.correct: Pression, éruption, coulée, refroidissement - tout le processus, lu et ordonné. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Que se passe-t-il profondément sous terre pendant longtemps avant une éruption ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Leia os passos. Coloque-os em ordem.
pt.prompt: O vulcão acumula pressão. Ele entra em erupção. A lava flui. Ela esfria e se transforma em rocha.
hints: A pressão se acumula silenciosamente por muito tempo antes de qualquer coisa acontecer.
pt.worked_example: Leia todos os passos primeiro. Qual deles definitivamente tem que acontecer primeiro?

feedback.correct: Pressão, erupção, fluxo, esfriar - o processo completo, lido e ordenado. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: O que acontece bem no fundo da terra por muito tempo antes de uma erupção?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi i passaggi. Mettili in ordine.
it.prompt: Il vulcano accumula pressione. Erutta. La lava scorre. Si raffredda in roccia.
hints: La pressione si accumula silenziosamente per molto tempo prima che accada qualcosa.
it.worked_example: Leggi prima tutti i passaggi. Quale deve assolutamente accadere per primo?

feedback.correct: Pressione, eruzione, flusso, raffreddamento - l'intero processo, letto e ordinato. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Cosa succede in profondità sottoterra per molto tempo prima di un'eruzione?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies die Schritte. Bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.
de.prompt: Der Vulkan baut Druck auf. Er bricht aus. Lava fließt. Sie kühlt zu Gestein ab.
hints: Der Druck baut sich lange leise auf, bevor etwas passiert.
de.worked_example: Lies zuerst alle Schritte. Welcher muss unbedingt als Erstes passieren?

feedback.correct: Druck, Ausbruch, Fließen, Abkühlen - der ganze Vorgang, gelesen und geordnet. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Was passiert lange tief unter der Erde, bevor ein Ausbruch geschieht?

nl.prompt: De vulkaan bouwt druk op. Hij barst uit. Lava stroomt. Het koelt af tot steen.
hints: De druk bouwt lange tijd stilletjes op voordat er iets gebeurt.
nl.worked_example: Lees eerst alle stappen. Welke moet absoluut eerst gebeuren?

feedback.correct: Druk, uitbarsting, stroom, afkoelen - het hele proces, gelezen en geordend. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Wat gebeurt er lange tijd diep ondergronds voordat er een uitbarsting komt?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Прочитай шаги. Расставь их по порядку.

feedback.correct: Давление, извержение, течение, остывание — весь процесс прочитан и расставлен по порядку. 🌋
feedback.incorrect: Что происходит глубоко под землёй долгое время, прежде чем извержение?

analysis.parent_note: Understanding that a process happens in stages, read directly from text, is real science literacy.

it.prompt: Ti fai un taglio. Sanguina. Si forma una crosta. Cresce nuova pelle.

feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

feedback.incorrect: Что происходит с порезом сразу после того, как он появился, до того как образуется корочка?

feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 读一读这些步骤,把它们排好顺序。

questions.subject: Science

questions.prompt: A whale is bigger than a fish.

academic.skill: reading a comparative science statement and matching an image

analysis.primary_construct: decoding a comparison statement and identifying the correct visual match
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Combines reading comprehension with comparative reasoning about physical properties.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Choosing an image that matches only part of the comparison shows partial, not full, sentence comprehension.
analysis.parent_note: Comparing things accurately from text is used constantly in real science reading.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Read the whole comparison aloud, emphasising the comparing word (bigger, heavier, faster).

academic.skill: checking several printed items against a category rule

analysis.primary_construct: reading a category rule then evaluating multiple printed options against it

pt.worked_example: Conte cada parte do gráfico com cuidado antes de compará-las.

feedback.correct: 25. Cinco símbolos vezes cinco animais cada, escalado corretamente. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Aqui, cada símbolo equivale a um grupo de 5, não a 1. Multiplique a contagem por 5.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi il grafico. Tocca la risposta.
it.prompt: Animali avvistati durante un safari: Elefanti 🐘🐘🐘  Leoni 🦁🦁  Giraffe 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   Se ogni simbolo rappresenta un gruppo di 5 animali, quante giraffe sono state avvistate in totale?
hints: Ogni simbolo rappresenta un gruppo di 5, non 1. Moltiplica.
it.worked_example: Conta con attenzione ogni parte del grafico prima di confrontarle.

feedback.correct: 25. Cinque simboli per cinque animali ciascuno, calcolo corretto. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Qui ogni simbolo equivale a un gruppo di 5, non a 1. Moltiplica il conteggio per 5.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies das Diagramm. Tippe die Antwort an.
de.prompt: Tierbeobachtungen auf einer Safari: Elefanten 🐘🐘🐘  Löwen 🦁🦁  Giraffen 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   Wenn jedes Symbol eine Gruppe von 5 Tieren bedeutet, wie viele Giraffen wurden insgesamt gesehen?
hints: Jedes Symbol steht für eine Gruppe von 5, nicht für 1. Multipliziere.
de.worked_example: Zähle jeden Teil des Diagramms sorgfältig, bevor du sie vergleichst.

feedback.correct: 25. Fünf Symbole mal fünf Tiere, richtig umgerechnet. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Hier steht jedes Symbol für eine Gruppe von 5. Multipliziere die Anzahl mit 5.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen - schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Lees de grafiek. Tik op het antwoord.
nl.prompt: Dieren gezien tijdens een safari: Olifanten 🐘🐘🐘  Leeuwen 🦁🦁  Giraffen 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   Als elk symbool een groep van 5 dieren betekent, hoeveel giraffen werden er in totaal gezien?
hints: Elk symbool staat voor een groep van 5, niet 1. Vermenigvuldig.
nl.worked_example: Tel elk deel van de grafiek goed voordat je ze vergelijkt.

feedback.correct: 25. Vijf symbolen keer vijf dieren elk, juist omgerekend. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Elk symbool staat hier voor een groep van 5, niet 1. Vermenigvuldig het aantal met 5.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Прочитай график. Нажми на ответ.
ru.prompt: Животные, увиденные на сафари: Слоны 🐘🐘🐘  Львы 🦁🦁  Жирафы 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   Если каждый символ означает группу из 5 животных, сколько всего жирафов было увидено?
hints: Каждый символ означает группу из 5, а не 1. Умножь.
ru.worked_example: Внимательно сосчитай каждую часть графика, прежде чем сравнивать их.

feedback.correct: 25. Пять символов умножить на пять животных каждый, правильно пересчитано. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Здесь каждый символ равен группе из 5. Умножь количество на 5.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.prompt: Safaride görülen hayvanlar: Filler 🐘🐘🐘  Aslanlar 🦁🦁  Zürafalar 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   Her sembol 5'lik bir hayvan grubunu temsil ediyorsa, toplamda kaç zürafa görüldü?
hints: Her sembol 1 değil, 5'lik bir grubu temsil ediyor. Çarp.
tr.worked_example: Karşılaştırmadan önce grafiğin her bölümünü dikkatlice say.

feedback.correct: 25. Beş sembol çarpı beşer hayvan, doğru şekilde ölçeklendi. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Burada her sembol 1 değil, 5'lik bir gruba eşittir. Sayıyı 5 ile çarp.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 读图表,点击答案。
zh.prompt: 野生动物园中看到的动物:大象🐘🐘🐘  狮子🦁🦁  长颈鹿🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   如果每个符号代表5只动物,一共看到多少只长颈鹿?
hints: 每个符号代表一组5只,不是1只。要乘一下。
zh.worked_example: 仔细数清图表的每一部分,再进行比较。

feedback.correct: 25。五个符号乘以每组五只,正确换算。📊
feedback.incorrect: 这里每个符号等于一组5只,不是1只。把数量乘以5。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: グラフを読もう。答えをタップしよう。
ja.prompt: サファリで見た動物:ゾウ 🐘🐘🐘  ライオン 🦁🦁  キリン 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   1つの記号が5匹のグループを表すなら、キリンは全部で何匹見た?
hints: 1つの記号は1匹ではなく5匹のグループを表す。掛け算しよう。
ja.worked_example: 比べる前に、グラフの各部分を丁寧に数えよう。

feedback.correct: 25。5つの記号×5匹で、正しく計算できたね。📊
feedback.incorrect: ここでは1つの記号が5匹のグループを表す、1匹ではない。数に5を掛けよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 사파리에서 본 동물들: 코끼리 🐘🐘🐘  사자 🦁🦁  기린 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   기호 하나가 동물 5마리 그룹을 뜻한다면, 기린은 모두 몇 마리 보였나요?
hints: 기호 하나는 1마리가 아니라 5마리 그룹을 뜻해요. 곱하세요.
ko.worked_example: 비교하기 전에 그래프의 각 부분을 꼼꼼히 세어보세요.

feedback.correct: 25. 기호 다섯 개에 5마리씩 곱해서 정확히 계산했어요. 📊
feedback.incorrect: 여기서 기호 하나는 5마리 그룹을 뜻해요, 1마리가 아니에요. 개수에 5를 곱하세요.
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.prompt: Hewan yang terlihat saat safari: Gajah 🐘🐘🐘  Singa 🦁🦁  Jerapah 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   Jika setiap simbol berarti sekelompok 5 hewan, berapa jumlah jerapah yang terlihat seluruhnya?
hints: Setiap simbol berarti sekelompok 5, bukan 1. Kalikan.
id.worked_example: Hitung setiap bagian grafik dengan hati-hati sebelum membandingkannya.

feedback.correct: 25. Lima simbol dikali lima hewan masing-masing, diskalakan dengan benar. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Setiap simbol di sini sama dengan sekelompok 5, bukan 1. Kalikan jumlahnya dengan 5.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Đọc biểu đồ. Chạm vào câu trả lời.
vi.prompt: Số lần nhìn thấy động vật trong chuyến safari: Voi 🐘🐘🐘  Sư tử 🦁🦁  Hươu cao cổ 🦒🦒🦒🦒🦒   Nếu mỗi biểu tượng là một nhóm 5 con vật, tổng số hươu cao cổ nhìn thấy là bao nhiêu?
hints: Mỗi biểu tượng tương ứng một nhóm 5, không phải 1. Hãy nhân lên.
vi.worked_example: Đếm kỹ từng phần của biểu đồ trước khi so sánh.

feedback.correct: 25. Năm biểu tượng nhân năm con vật mỗi biểu tượng, tính đúng theo tỉ lệ. 📊
feedback.incorrect: Ở đây mỗi biểu tượng bằng một nhóm 5, không phải 1. Nhân số lượng với 5.
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này với nhau - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the passage. Answer the question.
questions.prompt: Bees visit flowers to collect nectar. As they move from flower to flower, they carry pollen with them. This helps new seeds form.
hints: What does the passage say bees carry between flowers?
questions.worked_example: Read it in two parts. Check you understand each part before moving on.

feedback.correct: Pollen. Correctly read from the passage. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Read the passage again - what do bees carry as they move?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comprehending a short science passage

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Bees look busy because they are - they help our food grow.

analysis.primary_construct: holding multiple connected science sentences in mind together
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether comprehension holds up as science text length grows, a common dyslexia drop-off point.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct on single-sentence facts but wrong here signals a length or stamina effect, not a science-knowledge one.
analysis.parent_note: Shows how far your child's science reading stamina stretches before understanding slips.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Break the passage into chunks and check understanding after each one.

es.instruction: Lee el párrafo. Responde la pregunta.
es.prompt: Las abejas visitan las flores para recoger néctar. Mientras se mueven de flor en flor, llevan polen con ellas. Esto ayuda a que se formen nuevas semillas.
hints: ¿Qué dice el párrafo que llevan las abejas entre flores?
es.worked_example: Léelo en dos partes. Asegúrate de entender cada parte antes de seguir.

feedback.correct: Polen. Correctamente leído en el párrafo. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Lee el párrafo otra vez: ¿qué llevan las abejas mientras se mueven?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Lis le texte. Réponds à la question.
fr.prompt: Les abeilles visitent les fleurs pour récolter du nectar. En se déplaçant de fleur en fleur, elles transportent du pollen avec elles. Cela aide de nouvelles graines à se former.
hints: Que transportent les abeilles entre les fleurs, selon le texte ?
fr.worked_example: Lis-le en deux parties. Vérifie que tu comprends chaque partie avant de continuer.

feedback.correct: Pollen. Bien lu dans le texte. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Relis le texte - que transportent les abeilles en se déplaçant ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Leia o texto. Responda à pergunta.
pt.prompt: As abelhas visitam as flores para coletar néctar. Enquanto se movem de flor em flor, elas carregam pólen consigo. Isso ajuda novas sementes a se formarem.
hints: O que o texto diz que as abelhas carregam entre as flores?
pt.worked_example: Leia em duas partes. Verifique se você entendeu cada parte antes de continuar.

feedback.correct: Pólen. Lido corretamente no texto. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Leia o texto outra vez - o que as abelhas carregam enquanto se movem?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi il brano. Rispondi alla domanda.
it.prompt: Le api visitano i fiori per raccogliere il nettare. Mentre si spostano da un fiore all'altro, portano con sé il polline. Questo aiuta a formare nuovi semi.
hints: Cosa dice il brano che le api portano tra un fiore e l'altro?
it.worked_example: Leggilo in due parti. Controlla di aver capito ogni parte prima di continuare.

feedback.correct: Polline. Letto correttamente dal brano. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Leggi di nuovo il brano - cosa portano le api mentre si spostano?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies den Abschnitt. Beantworte die Frage.
de.prompt: Bienen besuchen Blüten, um Nektar zu sammeln. Während sie von Blüte zu Blüte fliegen, tragen sie Pollen mit sich. Das hilft neuen Samen, sich zu bilden.
hints: Was tragen die Bienen laut dem Abschnitt zwischen den Blüten?
de.worked_example: Lies ihn in zwei Teilen. Prüfe, ob du jeden Teil verstehst, bevor du weitermachst.

feedback.correct: Pollen. Richtig aus dem Abschnitt gelesen. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Lies den Abschnitt noch einmal - was tragen Bienen, während sie sich bewegen?
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen - schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Lees de tekst. Beantwoord de vraag.
nl.prompt: Bijen bezoeken bloemen om nectar te verzamelen. Terwijl ze van bloem naar bloem gaan, nemen ze stuifmeel mee. Dit helpt nieuwe zaden te vormen.
hints: Wat zegt de tekst dat bijen meenemen tussen bloemen?
nl.worked_example: Lees het in twee delen. Controleer of je elk deel begrijpt voordat je verdergaat.

feedback.correct: Stuifmeel. Juist afgelezen uit de tekst. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Lees de tekst nog eens - wat nemen bijen mee terwijl ze bewegen?
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Прочитай текст. Ответь на вопрос.
ru.prompt: Пчёлы посещают цветы, чтобы собрать нектар. Перелетая с цветка на цветок, они переносят с собой пыльцу. Это помогает образовываться новым семенам.
hints: Что, по словам текста, пчёлы переносят между цветами?
ru.worked_example: Прочитай его в две части. Убедись, что понимаешь каждую часть, прежде чем двигаться дальше.

feedback.correct: Пыльцу. Правильно прочитано из текста. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Прочитай текст снова — что переносят пчёлы, пока летают?
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.prompt: Arılar nektar toplamak için çiçekleri ziyaret eder. Çiçekten çiçeğe giderken polen taşırlar. Bu, yeni tohumların oluşmasına yardımcı olur.
hints: Metin, arıların çiçekler arasında ne taşıdığını söylüyor?
tr.worked_example: Metni iki parça halinde oku. İlerlemeden önce her bölümü anladığından emin ol.

feedback.correct: Polen. Metinden doğru okundu. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Metni tekrar oku - arılar hareket ederken ne taşırlar?
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 读短文,回答问题。
zh.prompt: 蜜蜂访问花朵来采集花蜜。当它们从一朵花飞到另一朵花时,会带着花粉。这帮助新的种子形成。
hints: 短文里说蜜蜂在花朵之间携带什么?
zh.worked_example: 分两部分读。读完每一部分都要确认自己理解了,再继续。

feedback.correct: 花粉。从短文里正确读出来了。🐝
feedback.incorrect: 再读一遍短文——蜜蜂移动时带着什么?
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 文章を読もう。質問に答えよう。
ja.prompt: ハチは蜜を集めるために花を訪れる。花から花へ移動する間、ハチは花粉も一緒に運ぶ。これが新しい種ができるのを助ける。
hints: 文章はハチが花と花の間で何を運ぶと言っている?
ja.worked_example: 2つの部分に分けて読もう。次に進む前に、それぞれを理解しよう。

feedback.correct: 花粉。文章から正しく読み取れたね。🐝
feedback.incorrect: もう一度文章を読もう - ハチは移動する間に何を運ぶ?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.prompt: 벌은 꽃을 찾아가 꿀을 모아요. 꽃에서 꽃으로 옮겨 다니면서 꽃가루도 함께 옮겨요. 이것이 새로운 씨가 생기는 것을 도와줘요.
hints: 글에서 벌이 꽃 사이를 옮겨 다니며 무엇을 나른다고 했나요?
ko.worked_example: 두 부분으로 나눠 읽어요. 다음으로 넘어가기 전에 각 부분을 이해했는지 확인하세요.

feedback.correct: 꽃가루. 글에서 정확히 읽었어요. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: 글을 다시 읽어보세요 - 벌이 옮겨 다니면서 무엇을 나르나요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.prompt: Lebah mengunjungi bunga untuk mengumpulkan nektar. Saat berpindah dari bunga ke bunga, mereka membawa serbuk sari. Ini membantu biji baru terbentuk.
hints: Apa yang menurut bacaan dibawa lebah di antara bunga-bunga?
id.worked_example: Baca dalam dua bagian. Pastikan kamu memahami setiap bagian sebelum lanjut.

feedback.correct: Serbuk sari. Dibaca dengan benar dari bacaan. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Baca bacaannya lagi - apa yang dibawa lebah saat berpindah?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Đọc đoạn văn. Trả lời câu hỏi.
vi.prompt: Ong bay đến các bông hoa để lấy mật hoa. Khi di chuyển từ hoa này sang hoa khác, chúng mang theo phấn hoa. Điều này giúp hạt mới hình thành.
hints: Đoạn văn nói ong mang gì giữa các bông hoa?
vi.worked_example: Đọc thành hai phần. Kiểm tra bạn hiểu từng phần trước khi tiếp tục.

feedback.correct: Phấn hoa. Đọc đúng từ đoạn văn. 🐝
feedback.incorrect: Đọc lại đoạn văn - ong mang gì khi di chuyển?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này với nhau - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the passage. Answer the question.
questions.prompt: Ice is frozen water. When it gets warm, ice melts and turns back into liquid water. This is called melting.

distractor_insight.freezing: the opposite process, not what's described
distractor_insight.evaporating: a different process, not mentioned in the passage

hints: What does the passage call this change?
questions.worked_example: Read it in two parts. Check you understand each part before moving on.

feedback.correct: Melting. Correctly read from the passage. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Read the passage again - what name does it give this change?
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: comprehending a short science passage

life_skill.hidden_lesson: Melting always goes solid to liquid - freezing is the reverse.

analysis.primary_construct: holding multiple connected science sentences in mind together
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether comprehension holds up as science text length grows, a common dyslexia drop-off point.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct on single-sentence facts but wrong here signals a length or stamina effect, not a science-knowledge one.
analysis.parent_note: Shows how far your child's science reading stamina stretches before understanding slips.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Break the passage into chunks and check understanding after each one.

es.instruction: Lee el párrafo. Responde la pregunta.
es.prompt: El hielo es agua congelada. Cuando se calienta, el hielo se derrite y vuelve a convertirse en agua líquida. Esto se llama fusión.
hints: ¿Cómo llama el párrafo a este cambio?
es.worked_example: Léelo en dos partes. Asegúrate de entender cada parte antes de seguir.

feedback.correct: Fusión. Correctamente leído en el párrafo. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Lee el párrafo otra vez: ¿qué nombre le da a este cambio?
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos: mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Lis le texte. Réponds à la question.
fr.prompt: La glace est de l'eau gelée. Quand elle se réchauffe, la glace fond et redevient de l'eau liquide. On appelle cela la fusion.
hints: Comment le texte appelle-t-il ce changement ?
fr.worked_example: Lis-le en deux parties. Vérifie que tu comprends chaque partie avant de continuer.

feedback.correct: La fusion. Bien lu dans le texte. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Relis le texte - quel nom donne-t-il à ce changement ?
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Leia o texto. Responda à pergunta.
pt.prompt: O gelo é água congelada. Quando esquenta, o gelo derrete e volta a se tornar água líquida. Isso é chamado de derretimento.
hints: Como o texto chama essa mudança?
pt.worked_example: Leia em duas partes. Verifique se você entendeu cada parte antes de continuar.

feedback.correct: Derretimento. Lido corretamente no texto. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Leia o texto outra vez - que nome ele dá a essa mudança?
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi il brano. Rispondi alla domanda.
it.prompt: Il ghiaccio è acqua congelata. Quando si scalda, il ghiaccio si scioglie e torna a essere acqua liquida. Questo si chiama fusione.
hints: Come chiama il brano questo cambiamento?
it.worked_example: Leggilo in due parti. Controlla di aver capito ogni parte prima di continuare.

feedback.correct: Fusione. Letto correttamente dal brano. 🧊
feedback.incorrect: Leggi di nuovo il brano - che nome dà a questo cambiamento?
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies den Abschnitt. Beantworte die Frage.
de.prompt: Eis ist gefrorenes Wasser. Wenn es warm wird, schmilzt das Eis und wird wieder zu flüssigem Wasser. Das nennt man Schmelzen.
hints: Wie nennt der Abschnitt diese Veränderung?
de.worked_example: Lies ihn in zwei Teilen. Prüfe, ob du jeden Teil verstehst, bevor du weitermachst.

es.instruction: Lee el texto. Responde la pregunta.
es.prompt: El agua se mueve constantemente en un ciclo. El sol calienta el agua de los océanos y lagos, haciendo que se evapore en el aire. En lo alto, se enfría y forma nubes. Finalmente, el agua cae de nuevo como lluvia, y los ríos la devuelven al océano, donde todo el proceso comienza otra vez.

Solo ocurre en los océanos, en ningún otro lugar

accepted_answers: Es un ciclo que se repite sin fin

Cela n'arrive qu'une seule fois, jamais plus

feedback.correct: C'est un cycle qui se répète sans fin. Bien lu dans un texte plus long. 🌊

feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.prompt: A água se move constantemente em um ciclo. O sol esquenta a água dos oceanos e lagos, fazendo com que ela evapore para o ar. No alto, ela esfria e forma nuvens. Eventualmente, a água cai de volta como chuva, e os rios a levam de volta ao oceano, onde todo o processo começa de novo.

Schließlich fällt das Wasser als Regen wieder herab, und Flüsse tragen es zurück zum Ozean, wo der ganze Vorgang wieder beginnt.

nl.instruction: Lees de tekst. Beantwoord de vraag.
nl.prompt: Wetenschappers volgen een zorgvuldige methode bij het onderzoeken van een vraag. Eerst stellen ze een duidelijke vraag. Ten slotte kijken ze goed naar de resultaten om te zien of hun gok klopte.
options: In een eerlijke test mag er maar één ding tegelijk veranderen
Voor een goede test moeten er veel dingen gelijktijdig veranderen
Een hypothese is het uiteindelijke antwoord, geen gok
nl.correct_answer: In een eerlijke test mag er maar één ding tegelijk veranderen
accepted_answers: In een eerlijke test mag er maar één ding tegelijk veranderen

ru.instruction: Прочитай текст. Ответь на вопрос.

Далее они разрабатывают честный эксперимент, в котором меняется только одна вещь за раз. Наконец, они внимательно изучают результаты, чтобы увидеть, было ли их предположение верным.
options: В честном эксперименте должна меняться только одна вещь за раз
В хорошем эксперименте должно меняться много всего одновременно
Гипотеза — это окончательный ответ, а не предположение
ru.correct_answer: В честном эксперименте должна меняться только одна вещь за раз

zh.instruction: 读短文,回答问题。
zh.prompt: 科学家在调查一个问题时会遵循一套严谨的方法。首先,他们提出一个明确的问题。然后他们做出一个假设,这其实就是一个有根据的猜测。接着,他们设计一个公平的测试,每次只改变一个因素。最后,他们仔细查看结果,看看自己的猜测是否正确。
options: 在公平的测试里,一次只应该改变一个因素
一次改变很多因素,测试才会更好
假设就是最终答案,不是猜测
zh.correct_answer: 在公平的测试里,一次只应该改变一个因素
accepted_answers: 在公平的测试里,一次只应该改变一个因素
hints: 短文里说什么能让一个测试变得'公平'?

feedback.correct: 一次只应该改变一个因素。从一篇较长的短文中正确读出来了。🔬
feedback.incorrect: 再读一遍短文,特别是关于设计公平测试的那部分。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: 文章を読もう。質問に答えよう。

options: 公平な実験では、一度に1つのことだけが変わるべきだ
良い実験のためには、多くのことが一度に変わるべきだ
仮説は予想ではなく、最終的な答えだ
ja.correct_answer: 公平な実験では、一度に1つのことだけが変わるべきだ
accepted_answers: 公平な実験では、一度に1つのことだけが変わるべきだ
hints: 文章は何が実験を「公平」にすると言っている?

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read the passage. Answer the question.
questions.prompt: Not all animals raise their young the same way. Birds build nests and feed their chicks until they can fly. Fish lay huge numbers of eggs and mostly leave them to hatch alone. Mammals, like humans, usually care for their babies closely for a long time, feeding them milk.

All animals raise their young in exactly the same way
Only mammals ever take care of their babies at all
questions.correct_answer: Different animal groups raise their young in different ways
accepted_answers: Different animal groups raise their young in different ways

distractor_insight.All animals raise their young in exactly: directly contradicts the passage's main point
distractor_insight.Only mammals ever take care of their bab: the passage also describes birds caring for chicks

hints: What's the main overall point this whole passage is making?

feedback.correct: Different animal groups raise their young differently. The main idea, correctly read from a longer passage. 🐣
feedback.incorrect: Think about the passage as a whole - what's the big comparison it's making?

academic.skill: comprehending a short science passage

life_skill.primary: Reading a longer science passage for the main idea
life_skill.hidden_lesson: Comparing how different groups of animals do the same basic task is real science thinking.

analysis.primary_construct: holding multiple connected science sentences in mind together
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether comprehension holds up as science text length grows, a common dyslexia drop-off point.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Correct on single-sentence facts but wrong here signals a length or stamina effect, not a science-knowledge one.
analysis.parent_note: Shows how far your child's science reading stamina stretches before understanding slips.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Break the passage into chunks and check understanding after each one.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read carefully. Tap what must be true.
questions.prompt: Leo's plant has bright green, upright leaves. His friend's plant, kept in a dark cupboard, has pale, drooping leaves. What can we infer?

academic.skill: drawing a scientific inference from a printed passage

life_skill.hidden_lesson: A plant's appearance often tells you a lot about what it needs.

analysis.primary_construct: combining information from printed text to reach a conclusion not directly stated
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - genuine scientific inference from text, the destination all other Read types build toward.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Strong inference here despite slower decoding elsewhere is the classic profile worth protecting and flagging.
analysis.parent_note: If your child reasons well here despite reading slowly, that gap matters more than the reading speed itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Let your child answer this kind of question aloud sometimes, so decoding speed never caps their thinking.

feedback.correct: 暖かくなる水が魚に影響しているかもしれない。慎重で、ちょうどよく不確かな推測だ - 本当に高度な推論だね。🐟
feedback.incorrect: 2つのパターンが一緒に起きている。どんな慎重で、あまり確信しすぎない結論が考えられる?
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 꼼꼼히 읽어요. 반드시 맞는 것을 두드리세요.
ko.prompt: 한 과학자가 어느 호수에서 특정 물고기가 해마다 훨씬 드물어지는 것을 알아챘어요. 그녀는 또한 호수 물이 해마다 더 따뜻해지는 것도 알아챘어요. 이것이 확실히 증명하지는 못해도, 무엇을 암시할 수 있을까요?
options: 따뜻해지는 물이 물고기 개체수에 영향을 주고 있을 수 있어요
따뜻해지는 물은 분명히 그것과 전혀 관련이 없어요
물고기들이 재미로 다른 호수로 옮겨가고 있어요
ko.correct_answer: 따뜻해지는 물이 물고기 개체수에 영향을 주고 있을 수 있어요
accepted_answers: 따뜻해지는 물이 물고기 개체수에 영향을 주고 있을 수 있어요
hints: 두 가지가 함께 변하고 있어요 - 완전히 확실하지는 않지만 신중한 결론은 무엇일까요?
ko.worked_example: 글에 직접 나오지 않아요. 사실들을 모아보면 무엇이 될까요?

feedback.correct: 따뜻해지는 물이 물고기에게 영향을 주고 있을 수 있어요. 신중하고 적절히 불확실한 추론이에요 - 정말 고급 수준의 사고예요. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: 두 패턴이 함께 일어나고 있어요. 너무 확신하지 않는 신중한 결론은 무엇일까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Baca dengan teliti. Ketuk apa yang pasti benar.
id.prompt: Seorang ilmuwan memperhatikan bahwa satu jenis ikan menjadi semakin jarang di sebuah danau setiap tahunnya. Ia juga memperhatikan air danau semakin hangat setiap tahunnya. Apa yang mungkin disarankan ini, meskipun belum membuktikannya secara pasti?
options: Air yang semakin hangat mungkin memengaruhi populasi ikan
Air yang semakin hangat pasti tidak ada hubungannya sama sekali
Ikan-ikan itu pindah ke danau lain untuk bersenang-senang
id.correct_answer: Air yang semakin hangat mungkin memengaruhi populasi ikan
accepted_answers: Air yang semakin hangat mungkin memengaruhi populasi ikan
hints: Dua hal sama-sama berubah bersamaan - kesimpulan hati-hati apa, yang belum pasti, yang mungkin mengikutinya?
id.worked_example: Bacaan tidak mengatakannya secara langsung. Apa yang dapat disimpulkan dari fakta-faktanya?

feedback.correct: Air yang semakin hangat mungkin memengaruhi ikan-ikan itu. Kesimpulan yang hati-hati dan tidak terlalu pasti - penalaran yang sungguh tingkat lanjut. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Dua pola sedang terjadi bersamaan. Kesimpulan hati-hati apa, yang tidak terlalu pasti, yang bisa mengikutinya?
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Đọc kỹ. Chạm vào điều chắc chắn đúng.
vi.prompt: Một nhà khoa học nhận thấy một loại cá nhất định ngày càng hiếm đi mỗi năm trong một cái hồ. Bà cũng nhận thấy nước hồ ngày càng ấm hơn mỗi năm. Điều này có thể gợi ý điều gì, dù chưa thể chứng minh chắc chắn?
options: Nước ấm lên có thể đang ảnh hưởng đến số lượng cá
Nước ấm lên chắc chắn không liên quan gì đến việc này
Những con cá đang chuyển sang một hồ khác cho vui
vi.correct_answer: Nước ấm lên có thể đang ảnh hưởng đến số lượng cá
accepted_answers: Nước ấm lên có thể đang ảnh hưởng đến số lượng cá
hints: Hai điều đang cùng thay đổi - kết luận cẩn trọng, chưa hoàn toàn chắc chắn nào có thể rút ra?
vi.worked_example: Đoạn văn không nói trực tiếp. Các chi tiết cộng lại nói lên điều gì?

feedback.correct: Nước ấm lên có thể đang ảnh hưởng đến số lượng cá. Một suy luận cẩn trọng, phù hợp với sự chưa chắc chắn - lập luận thực sự nâng cao. 🐟
feedback.incorrect: Hai quy luật đang xảy ra cùng nhau. Kết luận cẩn trọng, không quá chắc chắn nào có thể rút ra?
feedback.second_try: Hãy cùng làm câu này với nhau - xem cách làm nhé.

questions.subject: Science
questions.instruction: Read carefully. Tap what must be true.
questions.prompt: A patient took a new medicine and felt better within a day. But the patient also rested a lot and drank plenty of water during that same day. What can we say for certain about why they felt better?
options: We can't be fully certain it was the medicine alone
It was definitely only the medicine
It was definitely only the rest and water
questions.correct_answer: We can't be fully certain it was the medicine alone
accepted_answers: We can't be fully certain it was the medicine alone
hints: Several things changed at once - can we be certain which one caused the improvement?
questions.worked_example: The passage doesn't say it directly. What do the facts add up to?

feedback.correct: We can't be fully certain. A genuinely careful, advanced scientific judgement about mixed causes. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Think about how many things changed at once, and whether that makes one clear cause certain.
feedback.second_try: Let's do this one together - watch how it works.

academic.skill: drawing a scientific inference from a printed passage

life_skill.primary: Reasoning carefully about multiple possible causes
life_skill.hidden_lesson: This is exactly why fair scientific tests try to change only one thing at a time.

analysis.primary_construct: combining information from printed text to reach a conclusion not directly stated
analysis.diagnostic_purpose: The ceiling task of the module - genuine scientific inference from text, the destination all other Read types build toward.
analysis.behaviour_watch: Strong inference here despite slower decoding elsewhere is the classic profile worth protecting and flagging.
analysis.parent_note: If your child reasons well here despite reading slowly, that gap matters more than the reading speed itself.
analysis.teacher_action_if_missed: Let your child answer this kind of question aloud sometimes, so decoding speed never caps their thinking.

es.instruction: Lee con atención. Toca lo que debe ser cierto.
es.prompt: Un paciente tomó un medicamento nuevo y se sintió mejor en un día. Pero ese mismo día también descansó mucho y bebió mucha agua. ¿Qué podemos decir con certeza sobre por qué se sintió mejor?
options: No podemos estar completamente seguros de que fuera solo el medicamento
Definitivamente fue solo el descanso y el agua
es.correct_answer: No podemos estar completamente seguros de que fuera solo el medicamento
accepted_answers: No podemos estar completamente seguros de que fuera solo el medicamento
hints: Varias cosas cambiaron a la vez - ¿podemos estar seguros de cuál causó la mejora?
es.worked_example: El texto no lo dice directamente. ¿Qué nos indican los hechos en conjunto?

feedback.correct: No podemos estar completamente seguros. Un juicio científico realmente cuidadoso y avanzado sobre causas mixtas. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Piensa en cuántas cosas cambiaron a la vez, y si eso hace que una sola causa sea segura.
feedback.second_try: Hagamos este juntos - mira cómo se hace.

fr.instruction: Lis attentivement. Touche ce qui doit être vrai.
fr.prompt: Un patient a pris un nouveau médicament et s'est senti mieux en une journée. Mais le patient s'est aussi beaucoup reposé et a bu beaucoup d'eau ce même jour. Que peut-on dire avec certitude sur la raison de son amélioration ?
options: On ne peut pas être totalement certain que c'était le médicament seul
C'était certainement seulement le repos et l'eau
fr.correct_answer: On ne peut pas être totalement certain que c'était le médicament seul
accepted_answers: On ne peut pas être totalement certain que c'était le médicament seul
hints: Plusieurs choses ont changé en même temps - peut-on être certain de celle qui a causé l'amélioration ?
fr.worked_example: Le texte ne le dit pas directement. À quoi les faits mènent-ils ?

feedback.correct: On ne peut pas être totalement certain. Un jugement scientifique vraiment prudent et avancé face à des causes mélangées. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Pense à combien de choses ont changé en même temps, et si cela permet d'être certain d'une seule cause claire.
feedback.second_try: Faisons-le ensemble - regarde comment ça marche.

pt.instruction: Leia com cuidado. Toque no que deve ser verdade.
pt.prompt: Um paciente tomou um novo remédio e se sentiu melhor em um dia. Mas o paciente também descansou muito e bebeu bastante água nesse mesmo dia. O que podemos dizer com certeza sobre o motivo de ele ter se sentido melhor?
options: Não podemos ter total certeza de que foi apenas o remédio
Foi definitivamente só o descanso e a água
pt.correct_answer: Não podemos ter total certeza de que foi apenas o remédio
accepted_answers: Não podemos ter total certeza de que foi apenas o remédio
hints: Várias coisas mudaram ao mesmo tempo - podemos ter certeza de qual delas causou a melhora?
pt.worked_example: O texto não diz isso diretamente. O que os fatos somados indicam?

feedback.correct: Não podemos ter total certeza. Um julgamento científico cuidadoso e realmente avançado sobre causas combinadas. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Pense em quantas coisas mudaram ao mesmo tempo, e se isso torna uma causa clara certa.
feedback.second_try: Vamos fazer esta juntos - veja como funciona.

it.instruction: Leggi con attenzione. Tocca ciò che deve essere vero.
it.prompt: Un paziente ha preso una nuova medicina e si è sentito meglio in un giorno. Ma il paziente ha anche riposato molto e bevuto molta acqua durante lo stesso giorno. Cosa possiamo dire con certezza sul perché si è sentito meglio?
options: Non possiamo essere del tutto certi che sia stata solo la medicina
È stata sicuramente solo la medicina
È stato sicuramente solo il riposo e l'acqua
it.correct_answer: Non possiamo essere del tutto certi che sia stata solo la medicina
accepted_answers: Non possiamo essere del tutto certi che sia stata solo la medicina
hints: Sono cambiate diverse cose contemporaneamente - possiamo essere certi di quale abbia causato il miglioramento?
it.worked_example: Il brano non lo dice direttamente. Cosa suggeriscono insieme i fatti?

feedback.correct: Non possiamo essere del tutto certi. Un giudizio scientifico davvero attento e avanzato su cause multiple. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Pensa a quante cose sono cambiate contemporaneamente, e se questo rende certa una sola causa chiara.
feedback.second_try: Facciamo questo insieme - guarda come si fa.

de.instruction: Lies sorgfältig. Tippe an, was wahr sein muss.
de.prompt: Ein Patient nahm ein neues Medikament und fühlte sich innerhalb eines Tages besser. Aber der Patient ruhte sich auch viel aus und trank an diesem selben Tag viel Wasser. Was können wir mit Sicherheit darüber sagen, warum er sich besser fühlte?
options: Wir können nicht völlig sicher sein, dass es allein das Medikament war
Es war definitiv nur das Medikament
Es war definitiv nur die Ruhe und das Wasser
de.correct_answer: Wir können nicht völlig sicher sein, dass es allein das Medikament war
accepted_answers: Wir können nicht völlig sicher sein, dass es allein das Medikament war
hints: Mehrere Dinge änderten sich gleichzeitig - können wir sicher sein, welches davon die Besserung verursachte?
de.worked_example: Der Abschnitt sagt es nicht direkt. Was ergeben die Fakten zusammen?

feedback.correct: Wir können nicht völlig sicher sein. Ein wirklich sorgfältiges, fortgeschrittenes wissenschaftliches Urteil über gemischte Ursachen. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Denk darüber nach, wie viele Dinge sich gleichzeitig änderten, und ob das eine klare Ursache sicher macht.
feedback.second_try: Lass uns das gemeinsam machen - schau, wie es funktioniert.

nl.instruction: Lees goed. Tik op wat zeker waar moet zijn.
nl.prompt: Een patiënt nam een nieuw medicijn en voelde zich binnen een dag beter. Maar de patiënt rustte ook veel en dronk diezelfde dag veel water. Wat kunnen we met zekerheid zeggen over waarom hij zich beter voelde?
options: We kunnen niet helemaal zeker zijn dat het alleen het medicijn was
Het was absoluut alleen het medicijn
Het was absoluut alleen de rust en het water
nl.correct_answer: We kunnen niet helemaal zeker zijn dat het alleen het medicijn was
accepted_answers: We kunnen niet helemaal zeker zijn dat het alleen het medicijn was
hints: Er veranderden meerdere dingen tegelijk - kunnen we zeker zijn welke de verbetering veroorzaakte?
nl.worked_example: De tekst zegt het niet rechtstreeks. Waar wijzen de feiten samen op?

feedback.correct: We kunnen niet helemaal zeker zijn. Een echt voorzichtig, gevorderd wetenschappelijk oordeel over gemengde oorzaken. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Denk aan hoeveel dingen er tegelijk veranderden, en of dat één duidelijke oorzaak zeker maakt.
feedback.second_try: Laten we dit samen doen - kijk hoe het werkt.

ru.instruction: Прочитай внимательно. Нажми на то, что точно верно.
ru.prompt: Пациент принял новое лекарство и почувствовал себя лучше в течение дня. Но пациент также много отдыхал и пил много воды в тот же день. Что мы можем сказать точно о том, почему он почувствовал себя лучше?
options: Мы не можем быть полностью уверены, что это было только лекарство
Это точно были только отдых и вода
ru.correct_answer: Мы не можем быть полностью уверены, что это было только лекарство
accepted_answers: Мы не можем быть полностью уверены, что это было только лекарство
hints: Несколько вещей изменились одновременно — можем ли мы быть уверены, что именно вызвало улучшение?
ru.worked_example: Текст не говорит это прямо. К чему складываются все факты?

feedback.correct: Мы не можем быть полностью уверены. По-настоящему осторожное, продвинутое научное суждение о смешанных причинах. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Подумай, сколько всего изменилось одновременно, и делает ли это одну явную причину точной.
feedback.second_try: Давай сделаем это вместе — смотри, как это работает.

tr.instruction: Dikkatlice oku. Doğru olması gerekeni seç.
tr.prompt: Bir hasta yeni bir ilaç aldı ve bir gün içinde daha iyi hissetti. Ancak hasta o gün aynı zamanda çok dinlendi ve bol su içti. Daha iyi hissetmesinin nedeni hakkında kesin olarak ne söyleyebiliriz?
options: Sadece ilacın etkisi olduğundan tam olarak kesin olamayız
tr.correct_answer: Sadece ilacın etkisi olduğundan tam olarak kesin olamayız
accepted_answers: Sadece ilacın etkisi olduğundan tam olarak kesin olamayız
hints: Aynı anda birden fazla şey değişti - iyileşmeye hangisinin neden olduğundan kesin olabilir miyiz?
tr.worked_example: Metin bunu doğrudan söylemiyor. Verilen bilgiler neye işaret ediyor?

feedback.correct: Tam olarak kesin olamayız. Karışık nedenler hakkında gerçekten dikkatli, ileri düzey bir bilimsel değerlendirme. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Aynı anda kaç şeyin değiştiğini ve bunun tek bir nedeni kesin kılıp kılmadığını düşün.
feedback.second_try: Bunu birlikte yapalım - nasıl yapıldığını izle.

zh.instruction: 仔细读,点击一定正确的那个。
zh.prompt: 一位病人吃了一种新药后,一天之内感觉好多了。但这位病人同一天也休息了很久,并喝了很多水。关于她为什么感觉好转,我们能确定说什么?
options: 我们不能完全确定只是药物的作用
肯定只是休息和喝水的作用
zh.correct_answer: 我们不能完全确定只是药物的作用
accepted_answers: 我们不能完全确定只是药物的作用
hints: 同时发生了好几件事——我们能确定是哪一件造成了好转吗?
zh.worked_example: 短文没有直接说出来。这些线索加在一起说明了什么?

feedback.correct: 我们不能完全确定。一个关于混合原因的、真正谨慎而高级的科学判断。💊
feedback.incorrect: 想一想同时改变了多少件事,这是否让其中某一个原因变得确定。
feedback.second_try: 我们一起来做这道题——看看是怎么做的。

ja.instruction: よく読もう。正しいはずのことをタップしよう。
ja.prompt: ある患者は新しい薬を飲み、1日のうちに良くなった。しかし、その同じ日に、患者はたくさん休み、水もたくさん飲んでいた。なぜ良くなったのか、確実に言えることは何?
options: 薬だけのおかげだとは完全には確信できない
間違いなく薬だけのおかげだ
間違いなく休養と水だけのおかげだ
ja.correct_answer: 薬だけのおかげだとは完全には確信できない
accepted_answers: 薬だけのおかげだとは完全には確信できない
hints: いくつものことが同時に変わった - どれが良くなった原因かを確信できる?
ja.worked_example: 文章には直接書かれていない。事実から何が分かる?

feedback.correct: 完全には確信できない。入り混じった原因について、本当に慎重で高度な科学的判断だね。💊
feedback.incorrect: 同時にいくつのことが変わったか、それが1つの原因を確実にするかどうか考えよう。
feedback.second_try: 一緒にやってみよう。やり方を見てね。

ko.instruction: 꼼꼼히 읽어요. 반드시 맞는 것을 두드리세요.
ko.prompt: 한 환자가 새 약을 먹고 하루 만에 나아졌어요. 하지만 그 환자는 같은 날 많이 쉬고 물도 많이 마셨어요. 왜 나아졌는지 확실히 말할 수 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
options: 약만의 효과라고 완전히 확신할 수는 없어요
ko.correct_answer: 약만의 효과라고 완전히 확신할 수는 없어요
accepted_answers: 약만의 효과라고 완전히 확신할 수는 없어요
hints: 여러 가지가 동시에 바뀌었어요 - 무엇이 나아짐을 일으켰는지 확신할 수 있을까요?
ko.worked_example: 글에 직접 나오지 않아요. 사실들을 모아보면 무엇이 될까요?

feedback.correct: 완전히 확신할 수는 없어요. 여러 원인이 섞인 상황에 대한 정말 신중하고 고급 수준의 과학적 판단이에요. 💊
feedback.incorrect: 한꺼번에 몇 가지가 바뀌었는지 생각해보세요. 그것이 하나의 분명한 원인을 확신하게 해줄까요?
feedback.second_try: 이 문제는 같이 풀어봐요 - 어떻게 푸는지 잘 보세요.

id.instruction: Baca dengan teliti. Ketuk apa yang pasti benar.
id.prompt: Seorang pasien mengonsumsi obat baru dan merasa lebih baik dalam satu hari. Namun pasien itu juga banyak beristirahat dan minum banyak air pada hari yang sama. Apa yang dapat kita katakan secara pasti tentang mengapa ia merasa lebih baik?
options: Kita tidak bisa benar-benar pasti itu hanya karena obatnya
Itu pasti hanya karena istirahat dan air
id.correct_answer: Kita tidak bisa benar-benar pasti itu hanya karena obatnya
accepted_answers: Kita tidak bisa benar-benar pasti itu hanya karena obatnya
hints: Beberapa hal berubah sekaligus - bisakah kita pasti mana yang menyebabkan perbaikan itu?
id.worked_example: Bacaan tidak mengatakannya secara langsung. Apa yang dapat disimpulkan dari fakta-faktanya?

feedback.correct: Kita tidak bisa benar-benar pasti. Penilaian ilmiah yang sungguh hati-hati dan tingkat lanjut tentang penyebab yang bercampur. 💊
feedback.incorrect: Pikirkan berapa banyak hal yang berubah sekaligus, dan apakah itu membuat satu penyebab yang jelas menjadi pasti.
feedback.second_try: Ayo kita kerjakan ini bersama-sama - perhatikan caranya.

vi.instruction: Đọc kỹ. Chạm vào điều chắc chắn đúng.
vi.prompt: Một bệnh nhân uống một loại thuốc mới và cảm thấy khỏe hơn trong vòng một ngày. Nhưng bệnh nhân đó cũng đã nghỉ ngơi nhiều và uống nhiều nước trong cùng ngày đó. Chúng ta có thể nói chắc chắn điều gì về lý do họ cảm thấy khỏe hơn?
options: Chúng ta không thể hoàn toàn chắc chắn chỉ là do thuốc
Chắc chắn chỉ là do thuốc
Chắc chắn chỉ là do nghỉ ngơi và uống nước
vi.correct_answer: Chúng ta không thể hoàn toàn chắc chắn chỉ là do thuốc
accepted_answers: Chúng ta không thể hoàn toàn chắc chắn chỉ là do thuốc
hints: Nhiều thứ đã thay đổi cùng lúc - chúng ta có thể chắc chắn điều gì đã gây ra sự cải thiện không?
